tagline: OpenClaw Launch is a one-click deployment platform for OpenClaw AI chatbots
description: OpenClaw Launch is a one-click deployment platform for OpenClaw AI chatbots. Skip the manual setup — configure your AI agent visually, choose from 5,700+ skills, and deploy to Telegram, Discord, or web in under 30 seconds. Key Features - **Visual Configurator** — Point-and-click setup for OpenClaw agents, no coding required - **5,700+ AI Skills Marketplace** — Browse and add pre-built skills for moderation, summarization, code review, and more - **Multi-Platform Deployment** — Deploy to Telegram
